model.name: Sunburst center circle displays the TOTAL size of all children (human-formatted)
model.description: Tron (screenshot @v0.8.165, room Files folder detail): the child-size sunburst's CENTRE circle must display the TOTAL size of all its children, human-formatted. Today the centre shows no total. The value is the SUM of the child sizes (same on-disk bytes the arcs use) rendered in the human-readable format of R40.80 (SI B/kB/MB/GB/TB). Same sunburst surface/Impl as R37.21 (renderChildSizeSunburst a34f1a68). Screenshot = acceptance.

discoverySource.evidence: Tron screenshot of room Files folder detail @v0.8.165 (screenshot = acceptance, standing law tron-information-authoritative)

model.crossRefNote: Same sunburst as R37.21 AC-B-sunburst (Impl a34f1a68). Center value is human-formatted per R40.80 (the format rule). R40.79 owns the center-TOTAL element; R40.80 owns the format.
model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED — OPEN (Tron screenshot shows no center total); 0 Done till Tron; screenshot-@390 verifies.

acceptanceCriteria.text: WE verify @390 real-WebKit: the sunburst centre circle shows the TOTAL size = the SUM of all child sizes; the centre displays a total, not blank. Tron accepts.
The centre total equals the sum of the child arc sizes (same on-disk bytes). A centre total that does not match the summed children => wrong.

The centre total is rendered by the ONE product-wide size formatter (R40.80 AC-one-size-formatter-DRY), NOT a centre-specific reimplementation. WE verify @390 real-WebKit: the centre value uses the SAME format as the legend (e.g. 15.6 MB). DRY: centre and legend can never disagree.

model.drySharesFormatter: R40.79 center total uses the R40.80 single formatter (Tron DRY), never its own — center and legend are the same formatter by construction.
